import narwhals as nw
import pandas as pd

# Create sample DataFrame
df_native = pd.DataFrame({
    "user_id": ["123", "456", "789"],
    "score": [1.5, 2.5, 3.5]
})

# Convert to narwhals
df = nw.from_native(df_native)

# Convert dtypes
df_converted = df.select(
    nw.col("user_id").cast(nw.Int32),
    nw.col("score").cast(nw.Float32)
)

# Return converted frame (as native)
result = nw.to_native(df_converted)
print(result)
print(result.dtypes)
